SECTION III - RELATIONSHIP OF THE PROPOSED ACTION TO LAND USE AND WATER USE PLANS
3.01 Land Use Plans. Coordination with Federal and State agencies, and local municipalities has revealed that there are no known existing or propsed Federal, State, or local land use plans, policies, or controls for the area affected by the proposed project.
3.02 Water Use Plans. The Texas Water Plan, page III-35, November 1968, recognized the future addition of hydroelectric generating facilities at Amistad Dam. The plan also proposed, page IV-72, a Texas Water System which would include conveyance of water via a coastal canal to the Lower Rio Grande Valley. Walters proposed to be delivered in this coastal canal in part would replace additional diversions and water uses made from Rio Grande between Amistad Dam and Falcon Reservoir. Those proposed depletions included new irrigation in Maverick and Webb counties, and diversions to the Winter Garden area of the Nueces River basn for irrigation. The addition of the hydroelectric power at Amistad Dam is consistent with the State's plan.
3.03 Coordination. The written correspondence is displayed in Section IX.
